newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Magnum cuts Leisure unit stake.
newsitem.headline: Magnum cuts Leisure unit stake.

text.p: Malaysia's Magnum Corp Bhd said on Tuesday it had disposed of 20 million shares or a 20 percent interest in Leisure Management Bhd, through a private placement.
In a statement, Magnum said the shares were sold for 160 million ringgit or 8.00 ringgit per share.
Magnum's stake in Leisure Management has been reduced to 55 percent following the disposal, which would result in an extraordinary gain of 123.49 million ringgit for the group, it said.
Leisure Management is the sole agent of Magnum for the sale of four-digit betting tickets in Malaysia.
Shares of Magnum and Leisure Management were suspended on Tuesday pending an announcement. Magnum stock was last traded at 5.25 ringgit and Leisure Management at 9.60 ringgit.
